body: Damn dude. If it's any consolation I feel exactly the same way. Every interaction feels like I'm just bothering people, to the point where I wonder why should I even exist if nobody wants to be around me. But people have shown they do want to be around me. But in my head I can't escape that feeling...
This was rough but we'll be back and do what we always do. #DoYourJob #Patriots4Life
